subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class one-way A2A dispatch semantics now, and should that be a `sessions_send` mode/flag or a separate dispatch primitive?
rationale: The request is valid from current source behavior, but the permanent tool/API shape affects model-facing semantics, delivery acknowledgements, and compatibility with existing conversation-style `sessions_send` workflows.

options.title: Add a per-call dispatch mode
options.body: Extend `sessions_send` with an explicit dispatch mode that preserves existing default conversation behavior while giving controllers a one-way handoff path.

options.title: Fold into broader A2A redesign
options.body: Keep this issue open until the handoff acknowledgement and duplicate-delivery PRs settle, then design one combined A2A lifecycle contract.

options.title: Decline dispatch mode for now
options.body: Keep only global `maxPingPongTurns` and prompt/control-token patterns, accepting that pure handoff workflows remain unsupported as a first-class semantic.

recommendation.title: Add a per-call dispatch mode
recommendation.body: Extend `sessions_send` with an explicit dispatch mode that preserves existing default conversation behavior while giving controllers a one-way handoff path.

likelyOwner.reason: Current main history puts the relevant A2A sessions_send implementation and docs under this recent area work.
